title: Operation and Maintenance of Philadelphia Inactive Vessels - Performance Work Statement
description: SPECIAL NOTICE: The Department of the Navy, PAE Maritime, previously issued a Sources Sought Notice for this requirement under Solicitation Number N00024-26-R-4203. This special notice is being posted to notify industry of a significant change in the anticipated contract structure. Unlike prior contracts for these services, which were executed primarily under Cost and Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) terms, and in the spirit of Executive Order 14402 (Promoting Efficiency, Accountability, and Performance in Federal Contracting), the Navy is transitioning this upcoming contract to a hybrid contract structure consisting of Cost (including CPFF) and Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) line items. Additionally, a draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) is now attached to this notice to allow industry partners to review the specific tasks, performance standards, and deliverables expected under this contract. The Navy is seeking industry feedback on both this new hybrid contract structure and the technical requirements detailed in the attached PWS. Anticipated Contract Structure: The Government intends to award a single, hybrid contract. Industry is advised that this structure represents a departure from historical contracts for these services. To maximize cost discipline and efficiency: Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) elements are anticipated for well-defined, routine, and predictable operational requirements (e.g., standard physical security, routine warehousing, and recurring environmental monitoring). Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) and Cost-Reimbursement elements are anticipated for variable, high-risk, or emergent tasks (e.g., unpredictable vessel inactivation/activation cycles, emergent towing preparation, and specific hazardous material remediations). What/Where to Submit: Feedback on company letterhead that includes the name, telephone number, mailing address, and e-mail address of one point of contact to Commander, PAE Maritime, Attn: CDR Greg Sceviour. Please hand or properly digitally sign your feedback and e-mail it to the Contracting Officer, CDR Greg Sceviour at gregory.p.sceviour.mil@us.navy.mil and the Contract Specialist, Kevin Becker at kevin.r.becker2.civ@us.navy.mil with �INACTIVE Ships Philadelphia Special Notice Response� in the subject field. The feedback should include the following information: Hybrid Contract Capability & Feedback: Provide a description of your company�s experience managing hybrid contracts (specifically combining FFP and CPFF line items). What challenges or risks do you foresee with this hybrid structure for inactive ship maintenance, and what strategies would you use to mitigate them? Performance Work Statement (PWS) Comments: Provide any specific feedback, clarifying questions, or recommendations regarding the attached draft PWS. Please identify any areas in the PWS that you believe are highly suitable for Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) execution versus those that should remain Cost-Reimbursable (CPFF). Information provided shall be treated as Business Sensitive or Confidential to the responder, exempt from public release under the Freedom of Information Act. All information shall be provided free of charge to the Government. PAE Maritime SEA21I may request further information regarding the capabilities of respondents to meet the requirements set forth in the announcement. This special notice announcement is released in accordance with FAR 15.201 and FAR 5.205(c). This special notice is not a request for proposal. The purpose of this special notice is to gather information from the marketplace. Information provided in response to this special notice will not be considered an offer by the responding contractor and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. No telephone inquiries will be accepted and requests for solicitation packages will not be granted, as a solicitation has not been prepared at this time. When to Submit: Responses are requested no later than 1500 Local Time, Washington D.C. on 7 DECEMBER 2026. Disclaimer: This RFI is for Navy information/planning purposes only. This announcement is not a request for proposal; it does not constitute any form of solicitation and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Navy. A party submission is not an offer nor proposal and the Navy is under no obligation to make any form of award as a result of this announcement. No funds will be provided by the Navy to pay for preparation of submissions in response to this announcement. All responses to this RFI are strictly voluntary. All submitted materials will be designated for Government Use Only. Third party support contractors providing support to PAE21I Maritime will have access to the submitted material. These contractors have executed non-disclosure agreements with PAE21I Maritime. Submission of material requested in these sources sought announcement shall constitute consent to allow access to the material/information by any relevant third-party support contractor supporting PAE21I Maritime . Submitted material/information will be safeguarded in accordance with the applicable Government regulations. Other: Future information, if any, will be posted at the website for Beta SAM, https://beta.sam.gov/, the same site where this announcement is posted. Contracting Officer Address and Points of Contact: NAVAL SEA SYSTEMS COMMAND, DC 1333 Isaac Hull Ave SE, Washington Navy Yard, DC 20376 CDR Greg Sceviour, PAE Maritime Contracting Officer, gregory.p.sceviour.mil@us.navy.mil Kevin Becker, PAE Maritime Contract Specialist, kevin.r.becker2.civ@us.navy.mil

Jedná se o rekonstrukci stávající protihlukové stěny na úseku dálnice D5, vedoucí vpravo, u obce Kařez a Cekov. V úseku km 42,9 – 43,5 prochází dálnice D5 kolem stávající zástavby rodinných domů. Ze závěru akustické studie vyplývá, že stávající PHS bude navýšena o cca 2 m a navíc bude provedeno prodlouženi PHS na jejím začátku i konci celkové délky. Úprava PHS v daném úseku D5 byla projektantem navržena úplným snesením stávající protihlukové stěny a následně provedením nové PHS.
